annotations.title: Autonomous Web Hyperlink, Anchor & Asset Extraction Filter

description: Extracts, normalizes, and filters internal and external hyperlinks, anchor texts, and downloadable asset targets from HTML. Use when building site crawlers, auditing broken links, or extracting reference citations; for isolating primary readable article narrative text, use scrape_readable_article instead. Stateless read-only edge call (max 32 KB, 60 RPM): accepts 'html_content' ('link_scope' defaults to 'all_links'), supports '?demo=true' or L402 (10 sats), and returns HTTP 400 if invalid.

base_url.description: Base URL of the target page for resolving relative link paths.

html_content.description: Source HTML string containing anchor tags, href attributes, and link targets.

link_scope.description: Link extraction scope: all links, internal domain only, external links only, or download assets.

name: extract_page_hyperlinks

outputSchema.description: Deterministic execution response schema for extract_page_hyperlinks.

links.description: Array of link objects containing resolved url, anchor_text, and is_external.

total_links.description: Total hyperlinks discovered matching the specified link scope.

unique_domains.description: List of distinct outbound domain hostnames linked in the document.
